audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4-5, 6 and 2+ items all contradict the explanations printed under them: whys[2] and whys[3] say 'it's a wash' and 'the lane sits even here' yet the chart says Gragas; whys[4] calls level 6 'a genuine all-in' for Gragas yet the chart says Karma; whys[6] gives late to Karma yet the chart says Gragas.
audit.why: The packet chart — Karma, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Karma — matches the whys line for line, and matches a 51.68% win rate over 921 games where Gragas owns a mid window and Karma owns level 1 and the scaling.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Karma, flipped as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.why: Spikes match the kits: Karma owns 1-3 on Inner Flame's 950 range against Barrel Roll's 850; Gragas spikes at 6 with Explosive Cask (100/85/70s) and again at first item; Karma reclaims it late with Mantra on a 40/38/36/34s cooldown that her passive shortens further.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] describes Focused Resolve loosely as 'breaks if you LoS / outrange it' with no range or cooldown, so the player cannot judge whether he can actually break it.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 675 range on a flat 12s at every rank, and Riot's text is explicit that the root only lands 'if the tether is not broken' — breaking it is the entire counterplay, and 675 is short enough that Body Slam's 600-range collision usually keeps you inside it.
audit.corrected: Focused Resolve tethers at 675 range on a flat 12s — break line of sight to cancel the root, then E-slam + Q burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Throw R the wrong direction' but its description is boilerplate about burning a cooldown for tiny value and never says which direction is wrong.
audit.why: Explosive Cask knocks enemies back from its impact point, so a cask landed between you and Karma pushes her further away — the aim point has to be past her.
audit.corrected: Explosive Cask knocks back from impact — angle it toward you, not away.

edits.before: Track Karma's Focused Resolve: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. When it is down — E-slam + Q burst.
edits.after: Focused Resolve tethers at 675 range on a flat 12s — break line of sight to cancel the root, then E-slam + Q burst.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Explosive Cask knocks back from impact — angle it toward you, not away.

notes: No mirror audit existed for karma__gragas, so these findings are fresh. The level chart matched itself across both layers but contradicted the packet chart AND its own whys on four rows — including level 6, where the chart handed the row to Karma while the why under it calls the Gragas all-in lethal. Flipped as one atomic group in both layers with unchanged rows included so the group is complete. Karma's Mantra needs no skill point and is available from level 1, which is why level 1 is genuinely hers.
